visualReview.notes: Inspected the whole museum, four model angles, Grey Street garden, Melbourne Street entrance, stepped collection roof, and overpass. The concrete face has subdued joints and the dark entrance canopy now visibly projects above the blue-grey curtain wall.

sharedSurfaceReview.notes: Inspected the ten viewer captures for concrete, metal and glazing, including placement and unload. The building and attached walk share the same native heading. The flat-world fixture shows material and attachment behavior; the separate source field shows grade.

mediumFiReview.notes: Inspected all twenty-six current medium-fi views. The tiered volumes, garden opening, glazed entry and covered overpass read across all detail levels. The two nearest levels add window dividers, concrete vents, planters, stairs and bridge supports.

geographicReview.notes: The current museum perimeter is formed by native relation/18157403, two outer ways and the separate mapped entrance. The bridge follows eight native controls. Inspected the unmasked 378 m original Queensland Government elevation field. Only buildings covered almost entirely by the named museum perimeter qualify for replacement. Local thresholds and the bridge section are architectural estimates.

fidelityReview.scope: Standing Queensland Museum Kurilpa at South Bank, Brisbane, including the stepped concrete collection volumes, the full-height Grey Street Museum Garden, and the glazed street entrance with its attached approach to the Melbourne Street Overpass.
fidelityReview.notes: Used the named Arts Queensland conservation plan for the sandblasted pale concrete, stepped section and open garden. The cleared 2005 exterior establishes the projecting canopy, glazed pavilion and contemporary connecting walk. Exact roof setbacks, modern fittings, supported spans and minor openings are estimates.

imageryReview.notes: The named Figaro exterior already published on Qualla matches the native Commons bytes, named original uploader and item public-domain dedication. Used the exact local file for architectural proportions. Earlier museum premises and photographs with attribution licenses were excluded.

validation.sharedCaptureScope: Current geographic preview of Queensland Museum Kurilpa and its Melbourne Street pedestrian connection in South Brisbane.

limitations: The standing museum perimeter, main entrance point and bridge alignment are mapped. Upper setbacks, roof screens, planters, joints and service openings are proportioned from exterior and written evidence.
The conservation report establishes the full-height indoor-outdoor Museum Garden at Grey Street. Its bay divisions, planting and opening extents are estimates.
The glazed Melbourne Street entrance uses the surviving building form and an exact public-domain 2005 photograph. Reworked threshold, fascia details and the walk deck section are approximate.
The original Queensland Government elevation field is unmodified. The placement uses the Melbourne Street sidewalk datum and retains approximate contact across its different pedestrian levels.
